messages.subject: Query parameter security
parts:
Supposing I have published my shiny app at: https://shinyappsIO.myApp/
And my App only open if a query parameter is checked.
So typing the URL: https://shinyappsIO.myApp/PSW=mypsw
Will let me use application if parameter PSW is correct.
My question is:
The query parameter in the URL string are encrypted by https protocol or do they pass trough internet as plain text?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Query parameter security
parts: Any query parameters in a URL sent over HTTPS are encrypted. However, you should keep in mind that the query parameters will be stored un-encrypted in your browser's history.
